title: 10 Blocks Off Campus, One Reason Each
description: Explore the walkable corridors and commercial districts surrounding Agnes Scott College, from the historic Decatur Square to the Old Depot District.

cards.title: Decatur Square
cards.subtitle: The Historic Heart of Decatur
cards.notes: Walk three blocks north to reach this central plaza, home to the historic courthouse and frequent community festivals.
cards.short_summary: A central pedestrian plaza and historic district located just north of the Agnes Scott campus.
cards.evidence_claim: Decatur Square is a 15-block walkable district centered around the old DeKalb County courthouse, located a short walk from Agnes Scott.
cards.access_notes: Open 24/7 as a public plaza; business hours vary.

cards.title: East College Avenue
cards.subtitle: The Campus Frontage
cards.notes: Stroll along the northern edge of campus to find the Dalton Gallery and historic college-owned rental homes.
cards.short_summary: The primary thoroughfare bordering the northern side of the Agnes Scott College campus.
cards.evidence_claim: Agnes Scott College is located at 141 E. College Ave, and the street features college-owned historic homes like Agnes Arbor.
cards.source_title: Agnes Scott College Opens Three Historic Decatur Homes for Short-Term Rental
cards.access_notes: Public street with sidewalk access bordering the campus.

cards.title: South Candler Street
cards.subtitle: Historic Residential Corridor
cards.notes: Visit Charis Books & More, a historic feminist bookstore located at the corner of this residential street.
cards.short_summary: A historic residential street forming the eastern boundary of the college campus.
cards.evidence_claim: Charis Books & More is located at 184 S. Candler Street on the Agnes Scott campus corner.
cards.source_title: Charis Books & More - Agnes Scott College
cards.access_notes: Public street; bookstore open Mon-Sat 10am-7pm, Sun 12pm-6pm.

cards.title: Old Depot District
cards.subtitle: The Railroad Corridor
cards.notes: Explore this district anchored by the 1891 train depot, featuring local eateries and service providers.
cards.short_summary: A commercial district near the railroad tracks that caters to the local neighborhood and students.
cards.evidence_claim: The Old Depot District is a collection of locally owned businesses that cater to the nearby students at Agnes Scott College.
cards.access_notes: Walkable district located just north of the college across the tracks.

cards.title: West Ponce District
cards.subtitle: Dining and Fitness Hub
cards.notes: Walk northwest to find coffee shops like Dancing Goats and various fitness studios along this corridor.
cards.short_summary: A retail and dining district extending along West Ponce de Leon Avenue from the Square.
cards.evidence_claim: The West Ponce district features neighborhood-serving retailers, restaurants like Chai Pani, and fitness studios.
cards.access_notes: Public commercial district with wide sidewalks.

cards.title: Church Street
cards.subtitle: The MARTA Connection
cards.notes: Follow this street south from the Decatur MARTA station to reach the pedestrian tunnel leading to campus.
cards.short_summary: A primary north-south street connecting the downtown MARTA station to the Agnes Scott area.
cards.evidence_claim: Visitors exit the MARTA terminal on the Church Street side and head south to reach the college entrance.
cards.access_notes: Public street providing direct pedestrian access to campus via a tunnel.

cards.title: South McDonough Street
cards.subtitle: Western Campus Boundary
cards.notes: Walk along the western edge of campus to find the Higher Education Hub and access to the Oakhurst neighborhood.
cards.short_summary: A street forming the western boundary of the Agnes Scott campus, connecting to downtown.
cards.evidence_claim: The Higher Education Hub is located at 342 S. McDonough Street, adjacent to the college campus.
cards.source_title: Higher Education Hub - Agnes Scott College Calendar
cards.access_notes: Public street bordering the campus and residential areas.

cards.title: Sycamore Street
cards.subtitle: Historic Home Row
cards.notes: Explore some of Decatur's oldest homes and the public library along this quiet, tree-lined street.
cards.short_summary: A historic residential street known for its large 19th-century homes and proximity to the Square.
cards.evidence_claim: Sycamore Street contains some of the largest historic homes in Decatur, including the ca. 1830 High House.
cards.access_notes: Public residential street with sidewalk access.

cards.title: East Trinity Place
cards.subtitle: Downtown Retail Block
cards.notes: Find quick-service dining options like Chick-fil-A and local shops just a few blocks north of campus.
cards.short_summary: A commercial street in downtown Decatur featuring various retail and dining establishments.
cards.evidence_claim: Businesses like Chick-fil-A and Dairy Queen are located along East Trinity Place in the downtown district.
cards.access_notes: Public commercial street with standard business hours.

cards.title: East Court Square
cards.subtitle: The Square's Eastern Edge
cards.notes: Visit the iconic Brick Store Pub or grab coffee at Bellwood Coffee on this bustling downtown block.
cards.short_summary: A high-activity commercial block bordering the eastern side of the Decatur Square.
cards.evidence_claim: East Court Square is home to destination dining like Brick Store Pub and local coffee shops like Bellwood Coffee.
cards.access_notes: Public street bordering the pedestrian plaza of the Square.
